headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 18, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-6 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Junior Caminero leading the Marlins' offense. Ian Seymour pitched a strong 0.2 innings for the Marlins. In other news, the Baltimore Orioles took down the Washington Nationals 7-3, with Gunnar Henderson leading the offense. Henderson's impressive performance included four hits, one home run, and two RBIs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list. Corey Seager has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lower back inflammation, effective retroactive to May 15, 2026. Kyle Farmer has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 16, 2026, with a strained right forearm. Jose Altuve has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 17, 2026, with a left oblique strain.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Chicago White Sox have acquired center fielder Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove. The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Kyle Robinson from the Athletics in exchange for second baseman Alika Williams.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Nationals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Gunnar Henderson leading the offense. Henderson's impressive performance included four hits, one home run, and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Out Pirates 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a 6-0 victory. Zack Wheeler led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Red Sox 8-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing an 8-1 victory. Grant Holmes led the Braves' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 4 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Seager Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lower back inflammation, effective retroactive to May 15, 2026.

top_news.title: **Lauer Joins Dodgers Roster**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade. Lauer was previously traded to the Dodgers from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.
